result.summary: Enables the `-Wextra-semi` compiler warning flag in CMake and removes redundant semicolons across 67 files in the codebase. It also adjusts the fallback macro for `TRACEPOINT_SEMAPHORE` in `src/util/trace.h` to declare a forward struct instead of expanding to empty space, allowing trailing semicolons at macro call sites to compile cleanly under the warning.
result.problem: Extraneous semicolons after function definitions, class declarations, and namespace closures clutter the codebase and trigger compiler warnings under `-Wextra-semi`, which currently prevents the flag from being enforced across the project.
evidence: PR description: 'Enable -Wextra-semi and delete all the redundant semicolons.'
result.scope_notes: The PR touches 67 files mechanically and contains a temporary '[nomerge]' commit for libmultiprocess headers that the author notes will be replaced by an upstream subtree pull.
